t: Malta: “We must emerge out of this fog more resilient and energetic for a more competitive Malta” – David Xuereb
html:
“As The Chamber of Commerce, representing all economic activities within these sectors in Malta, we are living through one of the most exciting times of our lives. We are privileged to work closely with you, and to assist in every possible way, to make this new normal a success”, said architect David Xuereb, during the opening of an exclusive webinar for members of The Chamber of Commerce for Malta, recently launched by “BOV-MDB COVID Assist”.

Source: NET News

Updated 16:30
